content: Ligand 2 is a furylidene-benzofuranone, rigid and inactive; ligand 1 is the better host and it already has the right skeleton in outline - an anilide on an aminopyridine - but with two things wrong. Its pyridine is a pyridin-3-yl, so the ring nitrogen sits meta to the N-H rather than ortho, which is the arrangement I have measured at essentially zero, and its acyl side is a long benzofuran carboxamide tail. Atom 1 is the anilide carbonyl, bonded to the CH2 at atom 2 over a non-ring bond, so cutting there discards that whole fourteen-atom tail in one modification and lets me put a cyclobutyl on the carbonyl instead. Cyclobutanecarboxamide is the cap on my best molecule: cap ring size is activity-neutral across cyclopropyl, cyclobutyl and cyclopentyl, and the four-membered ring gives the best QED of the set. That leaves N-(pyridin-3-yl)cyclobutanecarboxamide, which I will then fix on the azine side.
